setup: [a message says a refund or a buyer's payment is waiting for the player and expires soon] [the amount is shown as already on its way]
ask: [the message, showing the amount as already on its way, asks the player to scan a code or approve a request in the wallet app before it expires to receive the money, with an amount the player did not type]
usualEnding: The scan pays them instead. No refund needs the player to approve an outgoing payment, and a real refund lands by itself inside the official app.
realTwin: A real refund notice from the shop the player bought from appears in the wallet app as money received, with nothing to scan and nothing to approve.
